title: Add user notification preferences
summary:
This PR adds user notification preferences, allowing users to choose which types of notifications they receive (email, push, in-app).

### Architectural changes

- Introduces a new `NotificationPreferences` domain (model, service, and repository).
- Adds a new API endpoint: `GET/PUT /api/users/:id/notification-preferences`.
- Persists preferences in a new database table (`notification_preferences`) via a migration.
- Integrates the preferences in the notification dispatch flow to filter out disabled channels.
author: jdoe

feedbacks.title: Extract validation to a schema
feedbacks.text: The route handler manually checks the incoming payload. A shared schema would make validation reusable, improve error messages, and keep the controller focused on request handling.
feedbacks.comment: Could we extract the request validation to a shared Zod schema? It would keep the route concise and ensure consistent validation across endpoints.

feedbacks.title: Handle potential null user
feedbacks.text: `userRepository.findById` can return `null`, which would cause a runtime error when accessing `user.notificationPreferences`. We should handle the null case explicitly.
feedbacks.comment: `user` can be null here. Let's handle the case (e.g., throw a `NotFoundError` or return early) to avoid a potential runtime error.

feedbacks.title: Add a database index for user_id
feedbacks.text:
The new preferences table will be queried by user ID on **every notification dispatch**. Adding an index may help this lookup stay efficient as the table grows.

Verify whether the unique constraint already creates one.
feedbacks.comment: Since we query preferences by `user_id`, can we confirm that this column is indexed? A unique constraint may already cover it.

feedbacks.text: The field name `isPush` is slightly ambiguous. A name such as `pushEnabled` makes it easier to understand that this is an opt-in preference.
feedbacks.comment: Tiny naming suggestion: `pushEnabled` might read more clearly than `isPush` here.
